notes: Paint strictly light to dark in five value bands on Y1 (Trumbull): (1) wet-on-wet cerulean/ultramarine sky lanes and pale warm ochre/hansa first stone washes holding bright paper reserves; (2) warm ochre/raw-sienna masonry masses on the sunlit central gable, right wing, sunlit sap-green tree crown, and foreground walk; (3) mid-tone shaded left masonry, cool slate roofs, textured ashlar stone blocks, and deeper foliage; (4) split cool-violet and warm-earth shadow glazes across eaves, foliage under-planes, and sidewalk shadows; (5) crisp dry sepia/ultramarine gothic window recesses, banner dark, and doorway accents, finished with selective closing sepia pen lines.
